title: LoopNet Commercial Real Estate Scraper
description: Extract commercial real estate listings from LoopNet search result pages.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Search page URL to start from. Query/hash parts like ?view=map are ignored automatically. If URL already contains /for-sale/ or /for-lease/, that transaction type is used.

listingType.title: Listing Type
listingType.description: Fallback transaction type used only when Start URL does not already include it.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Listings
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of records to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for paginated search pages.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy to improve reliability.
